title.value: Stochastic Hamiltonian Gradient Methods for Smooth Games
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning and consistently used throughout the document.
title.quote: Stochastic Hamiltonian Gradient Methods for Smooth Games

analysis.description: The paper investigates the convergence of stochastic Hamiltonian gradient methods in the context of smooth games, introducing novel unbiased estimators and variance-reduced methods. It provides theoretical convergence guarantees and supplements these with numerical experiments.

type.justification: The emphasis on providing theoretical convergence guarantees and analysis of Hamiltonian methods indicates a theoretical study.
type.quote: Using tools from the optimization literature we show that SHGD converges linearly to the neighbourhood of a stationary point.

name.justification: The paper focuses on optimization methods for stochastic smooth games, which is a sub-area in optimization applied to machine learning problems.
name.quote: In this work, we focus on solving two classes of stochastic smooth games.

name.justification: The paper introduces a variance-reduced Hamiltonian method, focusing on variance reduction techniques in optimization.
name.quote: We also present the first stochastic variance-reduced Hamiltonian method.

name.justification: The context of applying these methods to games in machine learning, such as min-max optimization problems, suggests a focus in this area.
name.quote: We provide the first set of global non-asymptotic last-iterate convergence guarantees for a stochastic game over a non-compact domain.

name.justification: The paper proposes the SHGD model as a novel method for optimization in smooth games.
name.quote: We propose a novel unbiased estimator for the stochastic Hamiltonian gradient descent (SHGD) and highlight its benefits.

is_contributed.justification: SHGD is introduced as a new contribution by the authors for the purpose of optimization in smooth games.
is_contributed.quote: We propose a novel unbiased estimator for the stochastic Hamiltonian gradient descent (SHGD).

is_executed.justification: The numerical experiments in the paper imply execution of the SHGD model.
is_executed.quote: We supplement our analysis with experiments on stochastic bilinear and sufficiently bilinear games, where our theory is shown to be tight.

is_compared.justification: SHGD is compared with other methods in numerical experiments to demonstrate its efficiency.
is_compared.quote: We show the benefits of the proposed methods by performing numerical experiments.

name.value: Loopless Stochastic Variance Reduced Hamiltonian Gradient (L-SVRHG)
name.justification: The paper introduces L-SVRHG as a novel method to solve stochastic smooth games.
name.quote: We study stochastic Hamiltonian gradient descent (SHGD), and propose the first stochastic variance reduced Hamiltonian method, named L-SVRHG.

is_contributed.justification: L-SVRHG is introduced as a new method in this paper.
is_contributed.quote: We propose the first stochastic variance reduced Hamiltonian method, named L-SVRHG.

is_executed.justification: The execution of L-SVRHG is implied through numerical experiments conducted with this model.
is_executed.quote: We show the benefits of the proposed methods by performing numerical experiments on simple stochastic bilinear and sufficiently bilinear problems.

is_compared.justification: L-SVRHG is compared with other models in experiments to assess its performance.
